claims.quote: A newly defined short smallest region of overlap (sSRO) within 3p25.3, encompassing approximately 52 kb and partially including SLC6A1 and SLC6A11, was associated with Angelman-like features, particularly epilepsy and EEG patterns.
These findings suggest that SLC6A1 dysfunction contributes to epilepsy and EEG abnormalities, possibly via impaired GABA transport,
